query: What happens to licensed rights and existing finished goods when the term ends, and what conditions govern renewal?
source_excerpt: 1. Term. The license begins on July 1, 2025 and ends on June 30, 2030, unless earlier terminated under this Agreement. Licensee may exercise a single two-year renewal option by written notice delivered not earlier than nine months and not later than six months before expiration, provided no uncured material breach exists on both the date of notice and the date of expiration. 2. Termination. Licensor may terminate if Licensee fails to pay a minimum royalty when due and does not cure that failure within 30 days after written notice. Either party may terminate if a force majeure event prevents its performance for 90 consecutive days. 3. Notices. Notices must be delivered personally or by certified mail, return receipt requested, to the notice address stated in this Agreement. A notice is effective upon receipt. 4. Wind-down and Reversion. Upon expiration or termination other than a termination resulting from Licensee's uncured material breach, Licensee may sell conforming finished inventory held on the effective date of expiration or termination for six months, provided all royalties are paid and Licensee continues to comply with the product-quality requirements. No sell-off is permitted following termination for Licensee's uncured material breach. At the end of an authorized sell-off period, Licensee shall stop sales and return or destroy remaining inventory at Licensor's direction. All licensed rights revert to Licensor upon expiration or termination; any permitted sell-off is limited to the inventory and period expressly stated in this section. Accrued payment obligations, confidentiality, and recordkeeping obligations survive.

query: Does the agreement grant a sell-off period after it ends, and when do the licensed rights revert?
source_excerpt: Effective Date; Term. This Agreement becomes effective on March 15, 2024 and remains in force until March 14, 2026, unless earlier terminated under Section 8. The parties may extend the term only by a written amendment signed by both parties no later than 60 days before expiration; no automatic renewal applies. Termination. Either party may terminate for convenience on 120 days' prior written notice. A party may terminate for the other party's material breach if the breach is not cured within 20 days after written notice. Notices. Termination notices must be sent by email to the notice address designated by the receiving party and by prepaid overnight courier to its principal business address; the courier copy controls if the two copies have different dates. Wind-down. On expiration or termination, Licensee shall stop manufacturing and marketing licensed products immediately. Within 15 days, Licensee shall return or destroy all remaining inventory and promotional materials, at Licensor's written direction, and certify destruction if requested. No sell-off period is granted. All licensed rights terminate and revert to Licensor on the effective date of expiration or termination. Payment obligations accrued before that date and confidentiality, recordkeeping, and audit provisions survive.

query: What rights apply to existing inventory after expiration or termination, and when do the licensed rights revert?
source_excerpt: 1. Term. This Agreement and the license granted under it take effect on January 1, 2025 and continue through December 31, 2027 (the Initial Term). The Agreement will automatically renew for successive one-year renewal terms unless either party gives the other written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days before the end of the then-current term. 2. Termination. Either party may terminate this Agreement for the other party's material breach if the breach remains uncured 30 days after written notice. Either party may terminate immediately by written notice if the other party becomes insolvent, makes an assignment for the benefit of creditors, or enters a bankruptcy proceeding. 3. Notices. All notices under this Agreement must be in writing and delivered by personal delivery or recognized overnight courier to the recipient at its address stated on the signature page. 4. After Termination. The Licensee may sell its finished, conforming inventory for 90 days after expiration or termination, provided it continues to pay royalties and comply with the quality-control requirements. At the end of that period, Licensee shall cease all sales and, at Licensor's election, return or destroy unsold inventory. Upon expiration or termination, all licensed rights revert to Licensor. Accrued payment obligations, audit rights, confidentiality obligations, and this inventory sell-off provision survive.

Either party may terminate immediately by written notice if the other party becomes insolvent, makes an assignment for the benefit of creditors, or enters a bankruptcy proceeding.

The Licensee may sell its finished, conforming inventory for 90 days after expiration or termination, provided it continues to pay royalties and comply with the quality-control requirements.
